english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the violin.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the stringed instrument.

examples.english: I learned to play the violin when I was little, and I can still play it now.
examples.traditional: 我細個學過小提琴，而家仲識拉。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 hok6 gwo3 siu2 tai4 kam4 ji4 gaa1 zung6 sik1 laai4

examples.english: I learned the fiddle when I was little, and I can still play a few tunes.
examples.traditional: 我細個學過小提琴，而家仲識拉幾首歌。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 hok6 gwo3 siu2 tai4 kam4 ji4 gaa1 zung6 sik1 laai1 gei2 sau2 go1
